    }
    for _, presetData in ipairs(shaderPresetButtons) do
        local data = presetData
        shaderCreateModeCard(ShaderModeGrid, {
            key = data[3],
            labelES = data[1],
            labelEN = data[2],
            descES = data[4],
            descEN = data[5] or (data[2] .. " atmosphere"),
            callback = function()
                ShaderDemoPreset = data[3]
                ShaderDemoEnabled = true
                shaderSetModeLabel(data[3])
                shaderApplyPreset(data[3], true)
            end,
        })
    end

    shaderCreateModeCard(ShaderModeGrid, {
        key = "Original",
        labelES = "Restaurar original",
        labelEN = "Restore original",
        descES = "Volver a la iluminación guardada del juego",
        descEN = "Return to the game's saved lighting",
        callback = function()
            ShaderDemoEnabled = false
            local report = shaderRestoreAll()
            shaderWarn(report, "Restauración")
            shaderSetModeLabel("Original")
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
        end,
    })
    shaderSetModeLabel("Morning")

    AutoTabShaders:CreateDivider()
    AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel("Overdrive local", "Local overdrive", 13)
    AutoTabShaders:CreateLabel(
        "Lluvia realista, superficies húmedas y presupuesto adaptable. Todo se restaura al desactivar el modo.",
        "Realistic rain, wet surfaces and adaptable budget. Everything restores when the mode is disabled.",
        10
    )
    do
        -- Grupos compactos de 2 columnas (antes: 11 filas grandes seguidas)
        local function overdriveGroup(icon, titleES, titleEN, items)
            local group = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = AutoTabShaders.Page,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 9,
            })
            group:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(group, 14)
            stroke(group, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = group, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})
            mk("UIListLayout", {Parent = group, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})

            local head = mk("Frame", {Parent = group, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 0, ZIndex = 10})
            local headIcon = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = head, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
            })
            headIcon:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(headIcon, 9)
            RowKit.Icon(headIcon, icon, 15, 12, "Accent")
            local headTitle = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = head, Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText(titleES, titleEN), TextColor3 = Theme.Accent, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 13,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
            })
            headTitle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
            headTitle:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", titleES)
            headTitle:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", titleEN)
            local counter = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = head, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                Text = "", TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, ZIndex = 11,
            })
            counter:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
            counter:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            counter:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            corner(counter, 999)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = counter, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9)})

            local grid = mk("Frame", {Parent = group, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 10})
            mk("UIGridLayout", {Parent = grid, CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 58), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})

            local states = {}
            local function refreshCounter()
                local on = 0
                for _, v in ipairs(states) do if v.get() then on = on + 1 end end
                counter.Text = GetText(on .. "/" .. #states .. " activos", on .. "/" .. #states .. " on")
                counter.TextColor3 = on > 0 and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim
                counter:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", on > 0 and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
            end

            for order, item in ipairs(items) do
                local state = item.get() == true
                local tile = mk("Frame", {Parent = grid, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 10})
                tile:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
                corner(tile, 12)
                local tileStroke = stroke(tile, Theme.Stroke, 1.2, 0.6)
                local tileScale = mk("UIScale", {Parent = tile, Scale = 1})
                local tileIcon = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0.5, -15), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11,
                })
                corner(tileIcon, 9)
                RowKit.Icon(tileIcon, item.icon, 16, 12, "Text")
                local tileName = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, -12), Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 6), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = GetText(item.es, item.en), TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11,
                    TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
                })
                tileName:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                tileName:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", item.es)
                tileName:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", item.en)
                local sw = mk("Frame", {Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -9, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 11})
                corner(sw, 999)
                local knob = mk("Frame", {Parent = sw, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 12})
                corner(knob, 999)
                local click = mk("TextButton", {Parent = tile, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 13})

                local function paint(animate)
                    local info = TweenInfo.new(animate and 0.2 or 0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                    TweenService:Create(sw, info, {BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(knob, info, {Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(tileIcon, info, {BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff, BackgroundTransparency = state and 0.55 or 0.4}):Play()
                    sw:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
                    tileIcon:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
                    tileStroke.Color = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.Stroke
                    tileStroke.Transparency = state and 0.15 or 0.6
                    tileStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "Stroke")
                end
                click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.45)
                    state = not state
                    tileScale.Scale = 0.95
                    TweenService:Create(tileScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
                    paint(true)
                    item.set(state)
                    shaderQueuePersistence()
                    refreshCounter()
                end)
                paint(false)
                table.insert(states, {get = function() return state end})
                Window._RegisterGlobalOption(AutoTabShaders, {
                    Id = "Shaders::" .. item.es,
                    NameSpanish = item.es,
                    NameEnglish = item.en,
                    Holder = tile,
                    Kind = "Toggle",
                })
            end
            refreshCounter()
        end

        overdriveGroup(114956632479378, "Superficies y reflejos", "Surfaces and reflections", {
            {icon = 109668384272715, es = "Reflejos húmedos", en = "Wet reflections", get = function() return ShaderReflections.Enabled end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 97860481644613, es = "Espejo de cielo en suelo", en = "Sky mirror on floors", get = function() return ShaderReflections.SkyMirrorEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 110711900112815, es = "Quitar texturas (reversible)", en = "Remove textures (reversible)", get = function() return ShaderReflections.StripTextures end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetStripTexturesEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 97733925946541, es = "Reflejo de objetos (espejo real)", en = "Object reflections (real mirror)", get = function() return ShaderReflections.ObjectMirrorEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(v) end},
        })
        overdriveGroup(108353110510004, "Personaje y modelos", "Character and models", {
            {icon = 113127542853193, es = "Sombras de modelos", en = "Model shadows", get = function() return ShaderReflections.ShadowEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetShadowEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 116161334433160, es = "Contacto del personaje", en = "Character contact", get = function() return ShaderReflections.ContactEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetContactEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 100212473103391, es = "Brillo solar del personaje", en = "Character solar sheen", get = function() return ShaderReflections.CharacterSpecularEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetCharacterSpecularEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 95096736026306, es = "Excluir mi avatar", en = "Exclude my avatar", get = function() return ShaderReflections.ExcludeLocalAvatar end, set = function(v) ShaderReflections:SetExcludeLocalAvatar(v) end},
        })
        overdriveGroup(98854559186277, "Lluvia y clima", "Rain and weather", {
            {icon = 98854559186277, es = "Lluvia física", en = "Physical rain", get = function() return ShaderRain.Enabled end, set = function(v) ShaderRain:SetEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 72126043741813, es = "Audio de lluvia", en = "Rain audio", get = function() return ShaderRain.SoundEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderRain:SetSoundEnabled(v) end},
            {icon = 139958464372083, es = "Relámpagos dinámicos", en = "Dynamic lightning", get = function() return ShaderRain.StormEnabled end, set = function(v) ShaderRain:SetStormEnabled(v) end},
        })
    end

    Window.Shaders = {
        Core = ShaderManager,
        Presets = ShaderPresets,
        Catalog = ShaderPropertyCatalog,
        Apply = function(patch, options)
            local report = ShaderManager:Apply(patch, options or {})
            shaderWarn(report, "Aplicación manual")
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
            if report and report.ok then shaderQueuePersistence() end
            return report
        end,
        ApplyPreset = function(name, options)
            local report = ShaderManager:ApplyPreset(name, options or {})
            if report.ok then
                shaderSyncImmersivePreset(name)
                pcall(PerfOpt.AfterShaders)
            end
            shaderWarn(report, "Preset " .. tostring(name))
            shaderSetModeLabel(name)
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
            if report and report.ok then shaderQueuePersistence() end
            return report
        end,
        RegisterPreset = function(name, preset)
            ShaderManager:RegisterPreset(name, preset)
        end,
        RegisterTarget = function(id, spec)
            return ShaderManager:RegisterTarget(id, spec)
        end,
        ApplyTo = function(instance, properties, options)
            local report = ShaderManager:ApplyTo(instance, properties, options or {})
            shaderWarn(report, "Aplicación directa")
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
            return report
        end,
        Restore = function(options)
            local report = shaderRestoreAll(options)
            ShaderCustomRefresh()
            return report
        end,
        GetTarget = function(id, createIfMissing)
            return ShaderManager:GetTarget(id, createIfMissing)
        end,
        Read = function(targetId, properties)
            return ShaderManager:Read(targetId, properties)
        end,
        SetSkyMirrorEnabled = function(enabled)
            ShaderReflections:SetSkyMirrorEnabled(enabled)
            shaderQueuePersistence()
        end,
        OpenCustom = shaderOpenCustomWindow,
        CloseCustom = function()
            if ShaderCustomWindow then
                shaderDisconnectAll()
                if ShaderCustomWindow then ShaderCustomWindow:Destroy() end
                if ShaderCustomBackdrop then ShaderCustomBackdrop:Destroy() end
                ShaderCustomWindow = nil
                ShaderCustomBackdrop = nil
                ShaderCustomControls = {}
                ShaderCustomRefresh = function() end
            end
        end,
        GetActivePreset = function()
            return ShaderManager.ActivePreset
        end,
        IsDemoEnabled = function()
            return ShaderDemoEnabled
        end,
        Overdrive = {
            SetQuality = shaderSetQuality,
            GetQuality = function() return ShaderSceneQuality end,
            Reflections = {
                SetEnabled = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetEnabled(value) end,
                SetIntensity = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetIntensity(value) end,
                SetWetness = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetWetness(value) end,
                SetSurfaceMode = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetSurfaceMode(value) end,
                SetSceneCoverage = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetSceneCoverage(value) end,
                SetObjectMirrorEnabled = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetObjectMirrorEnabled(value) end,
                SetContactEnabled = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetContactEnabled(value) end,
                SetContactStrength = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetContactStrength(value) end,
                SetModelDetailEnabled = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetModelDetailEnabled(value) end,
                SetShadowEnabled = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetShadowEnabled(value) end,
                SetShadowStrength = function(value) ShaderReflections:SetShadowStrength(value) end,
                SetSunHue = function(value) ShaderSolarTone:SetHue(value) end,
                SetSunSaturation = function(value) ShaderSolarTone:SetSaturation(value) end,
                SetSunStrength = function(value) ShaderSolarTone:SetStrength(value) end,
                Refresh = function() ShaderReflections:Refresh() end,
                IsEnabled = function() return ShaderReflections.Enabled end,
            },
            Rain = {
                SetEnabled = function(value) ShaderRain:SetEnabled(value) end,
                SetIntensity = function(value) ShaderRain:SetIntensity(value) end,
                SetSoundEnabled = function(value) ShaderRain:SetSoundEnabled(value) end,
                SetSoundVolume = function(value) ShaderRain:SetSoundVolume(value) end,
                SetRespectShelter = function(value) ShaderRain:SetRespectShelter(value) end,
                SetStormEnabled = function(value) ShaderRain:SetStormEnabled(value) end,
                IsEnabled = function() return ShaderRain.Enabled end,
            },
            Restore = shaderRestoreImmersive,
        },
    }

    end

    Window:InitializeShaderSystem()

    local ChatApi = nil -- chat global v14 (se crea más abajo, en la pestaña Chat)

    local AutoTabAjustes = Window:CreateTab("Ajustes", "Settings", "rbxassetid://98148562257039")
    BuildAjustesExtras(
        Window,
        AutoTabAjustes,
        function()
            return SlidersHidden
        end,
        function(value)
            SlidersHidden = value
        end,
        function()
            if ChatApi then return ChatApi.GetSideNotifs() end
            return SavedConfig.ChatCornerMessages ~= false
        end,
        function(value)
            -- "Mensajes del Chat en esquina" = avisos al costado del chat v14
            if ChatApi then ChatApi.SetSideNotifs(value) end
        end
    )

    
    


    local function noop() end
    Window.ChatMessages = {}
    Window.RenderedChatFrames = {}
    Window.TrackChatFrame = noop
    Window.AddChatMessage = noop
    Window.RenderChatMessage = noop
    Window.SendMessage = noop
    Window.SetReplyTarget = noop
    Window.ClearReplyTarget = noop
    Window.SendServerInvite = noop
    Window.RenderInviteCard = noop
    function Window:SendChatMessage() end
    function Window:GetChatHistory() return Window.ChatMessages end
    function Window:ReceiveMessage() end
    function Window:SetUserBubbleAsset() end
    function Window:SetUserBubbleStyle() end
    function Window:InitializeChatStickers() end

    -- ===== CHAT GLOBAL (v14 integrado) =====
    local ChatTab = Window:CreateTab("Chat", "Chat", "rbxassetid://82910060656954")
    local ChatTabPage = ChatTab.Page
    ChatTabPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    ChatTabPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
    ChatTabPage.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    ChatTabPage.ScrollingEnabled = false

    local ChatHost = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ChatTabPage,
        Name = "ChatGlobalHost",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    -- v15: los colores/efectos de texto de la librería no tocan el chat global
    Window._ThemeIsolatedRoot = ChatHost
    if Window._InvalidateTextObjects then Window._InvalidateTextObjects() end

    -- globo de no leídos en el botón de la pestaña
    local ChatBadge = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ChatTab.Button,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 55),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 20,
    })
    corner(ChatBadge, 999)
    local ChatBadgeLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = ChatBadge,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "0",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 10,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        ZIndex = 21,
    })
    local lastBadge = 0
    local function setChatBadge(total)
        total = tonumber(total) or 0
        ChatBadge.Visible = total > 0
        if total > 0 then
            ChatBadgeLabel.Text = total > 99 and "99+" or tostring(total)
            if total > lastBadge then
                ChatBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
                TweenService:Create(ChatBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }):Play()
            end
        end
        lastBadge = total
    end

    local okChat, chatResult = pcall(YinYang._BuildChatGlobal, {
        Host = ChatHost,
        Glass = function(parent)
            local image = mk("ImageLabel", {Name = "ChatGlass", Parent = parent,
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageTransparency = 0.35, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, ZIndex = parent.ZIndex})
            corner(image, 18)
            YinIcons.get("spotify-glass", function(asset) if image.Parent then image.Image = asset end end)
        end,
        OverlayParent = ScreenGui.Parent,
        OnlineLabel = TopBarOnlineLabel,
        SetBadge = setChatBadge,
        Open = function()
            pcall(function() Window:Show() end)
            if ChatTab.Select then ChatTab.Select() end
        end,
    })
    if okChat and type(chatResult) == "table" then
        ChatApi = chatResult
        if SavedConfig.ChatCornerMessages == false then
            pcall(ChatApi.SetSideNotifs, false)
        end
        ScreenGui.Destroying:Connect(function() pcall(ChatApi.Destroy) end)
    else
        warn("[ChatGlobal] No se pudo iniciar el chat: " .. tostring(chatResult))
    end

    -- Vista inmersiva del chat: un único fondo del tema cubre toda la ventana.
    do
        local A = {Active = false}
        Window._ChatAmbient = A
        local shade = mk("Frame", {Name = "ChatAmbientShade", Parent = Main,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 7, 11),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.48, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 6})
        corner(shade, 10)
        function A.Layout()
            if not A.Active then return end
            local compact = Window.CompactNavigation == true
            local side = compact and 58 or 110
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, -56)
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side, 1, 56)
            TabListArt.Visible = false
            CatImage.Visible = false
            local rail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
            if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = 0.68 end
            if ChatApi and ChatApi.SetHeaderInset then ChatApi.SetHeaderInset(compact and 66 or 0) end
        end
        function A.enter()
            if A.Active then return end
            A.Active = true
            A.saved = {visible = {}, top = TopBar.BackgroundTransparency,
                tabs = TabList.BackgroundTransparency, titleSize = TitleLabel.Size,
                titleZ = TitleLabel.ZIndex, badgeZ = DaraHubLabel.ZIndex,
                badgeFrameZ = DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex}
            for _, obj in ipairs({BannerFrame, BoomboxPill, WindowControls, TopBarCounter,
                TitleDivider, TopBarArt, TabListArt, CatImage, Main:FindFirstChild("RotatingSubText")}) do
                if obj then A.saved.visible[obj] = obj.Visible; obj.Visible = false end
            end
            BackgroundArt.Parent = Main
            BackgroundArt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            BackgroundArt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            shade.Visible = true
            TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(106, 26)
            TitleLabel.ZIndex = 60
            DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex = 60
            DaraHubLabel.ZIndex = 61
            A.Layout()
        end
        function A.leave()
            if not A.Active then return end
            A.Active = false
            shade.Visible = false
            for obj, visible in pairs(A.saved.visible or {}) do if obj.Parent then obj.Visible = visible end end
            Window._ApplyFullBackground()
            TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = A.saved.top
            TabList.BackgroundTransparency = A.saved.tabs
            TitleLabel.Size = A.saved.titleSize
            TitleLabel.ZIndex = A.saved.titleZ
            DaraHubLabel.ZIndex = A.saved.badgeZ
            DaraHubLabel.Parent.ZIndex = A.saved.badgeFrameZ
            local compact = Window.CompactNavigation == true
            local side = compact and 58 or 110
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, side, 0, 0)
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -side, 1, 0)
            TabListArt.Visible = not compact
            CatImage.Visible = not compact and Theme.ThemeName == "Dark"
            local rail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
            if rail then rail.BackgroundTransparency = 0.10 end
            if ChatApi and ChatApi.SetHeaderInset then ChatApi.SetHeaderInset(0) end
        end
        track(ChatTabPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            task.defer(function()
                if ChatTabPage.Parent then
                    if ChatTabPage.Visible then A.enter() else A.leave() end
                end
            end)
        end))
        if ChatTabPage.Visible then A.enter() end
    end

    RefreshLibraryLanguage = function()
        for _, el in ipairs(Window.ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if el:IsA("TextLabel") or el:IsA("TextButton") or el:IsA("TextBox") then
                local sp = el:GetAttribute("TextSpanish")
                local en = el:GetAttribute("TextEnglish")
                if sp and en then
                    el.Text = GetText(sp, en)
                end

                if el:IsA("TextBox") then
                    local psp = el:GetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish")
                    local pen = el:GetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish")
                    if psp and pen then
                        el.PlaceholderText = GetText(psp, pen)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local lastLanguage = LibraryLanguage
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if LibraryLanguage == lastLanguage then
            return
        end
        lastLanguage = LibraryLanguage
        RefreshLibraryLanguage()
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            task.wait(0.25)
            RefreshLibraryLanguage()
        end
    end)

    function Window:CreateCreditsTab()

    local CredRoot_

    local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)

    local function text(props, es, en, role)
        local label = mk("TextLabel", props)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        if es then
            label.Text = GetText(es, en)
            label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
            label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
        end
        if role then label:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", role) end
        return label
    end

    local function card(order, height)
        local c = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = CredRoot_,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            LayoutOrder = order,
            ZIndex = 10,
        })
        c:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
        corner(c, 16)
        stroke(c, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
        return c
    end

    local function socialCard(order, platform, displayName, handle, link, imageName, offset, dimensions)
        local c = card(order, 110)
        c.ClipsDescendants = true
        local portrait = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = c, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "rbxassetid://125311226076728", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 11,
        })
        corner(portrait, 999)
        local border = mk("UIStroke", {Parent = portrait, Color = Theme.Stroke, Thickness = 1.4, Transparency = 0.18})
        border:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Stroke")
        local stripe = mk("Frame", {Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 13),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -26), BorderSizePixel = 0,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, ZIndex = 11})
        stripe:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(stripe, 4)
        local platformLabel = text({
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 14),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
            Text = platform, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
        }, nil, nil, "Accent")
        text({
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 25), Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 21),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Text = displayName, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
        }, nil, nil, "Text")
        text({
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 47), Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 17),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            Text = handle, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 11,
        }, nil, nil, "TextDim")
        local copy = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = c, Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -37), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.85,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 12,
        })
        copy:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(copy, 8)
        local label = text({
            Parent = copy, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 13,
        }, "Copiar enlace", "Copy link", "Text")
        local serial = 0
        local address
        copy.Activated:Connect(function()
            local copied = type(setclipboard) == "function" and pcall(setclipboard, link)
            if not copied then
                copy.Visible = false
                address.Visible = true
                address:CaptureFocus()
                return
            end
            serial = serial + 1
            local this = serial
            label.Text = copied and GetText("✓ Enlace copiado", "✓ Link copied")
                or GetText("No se pudo copiar", "Could not copy")
            task.delay(2.5, function()
                if this == serial and copy.Parent then label.Text = GetText("Copiar enlace", "Copy link") end
            end)
        end)
        -- El enlace también queda disponible para selección manual sin portapapeles.
        address = mk("TextBox", {
            Parent = c, Name = platform .. "Link", Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -37),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            Text = link, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 10,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextEditable = false, Visible = false, ZIndex = 14,
        })
        corner(address, 8)
        address.FocusLost:Connect(function() address.Visible = false copy.Visible = true end)
        copy:SetAttribute("Link", link)
        task.spawn(function()
            if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return end
            local ok, asset = pcall(function()
                local localName = "YinCredits_" .. imageName
                if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(localName) then
                    local data = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YinScripts/Yin-UI/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/" .. imageName)
                    if type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 100 then return nil end
                    writefile(localName, data)
                end
                return getcustomasset(localName)
            end)
            if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" and portrait.Parent then
                portrait.Image = asset
                portrait.ImageRectOffset = offset
                portrait.ImageRectSize = dimensions
            end
        end)
    end
    socialCard(5, "YOUTUBE", "Yin yang | New Script", "@Yin-Yang-Hub",
        "https://youtube.com/@yin-yang-hub?si=lX7-WkyujSdjX7i7", "credit-youtube.jpg",
        Vector2.new(42, 310), Vector2.new(188, 188))
